tmua-2021-p2-q1.summary: Calculate the definite integral of $3\sqrt{x}+4/x^2$ from $x=1$ to $x=4$.
tmua-2021-p2-q1.summaryZh: 求 $3\sqrt{x}+4/x^2$ 在区间 $[1,4]$ 上的定积分。

methods.title: Integrate each power
steps: An antiderivative of $3x^{1/2}+4x^{-2}$ is $F(x)=2x^{3/2}-4/x$.
Subtract the endpoint values: $F(4)-F(1)=(16-1)-(2-4)=17$.

tmua-2021-p2-q2.summary: The endpoints of one diagonal of a square are $(0,2)$ and $(4,0)$. Find the line containing the other diagonal.
tmua-2021-p2-q2.summaryZh: 一个正方形的一条对角线以 $(0,2)$、$(4,0)$ 为端点。求另一条对角线所在直线的方程。

methods.title: Bisect the first diagonal perpendicularly
methods.titleZh: 作第一条对角线的垂直平分线
steps: The two diagonals share the midpoint $(2,1)$. The given diagonal has slope $(0-2)/(4-0)=-1/2$.
Perpendicularity gives slope $2$ for the other diagonal, so $y-1=2(x-2)$.
stepsZh: 两条对角线的公共中点为 $(2,1)$，已知对角线的斜率为 $(0-2)/(4-0)=-1/2$。
由垂直关系，另一条对角线的斜率是 $2$，所以 $y-1=2(x-2)$。

methods.title: Equate distances to the opposite vertices
steps: Both ends of the other diagonal are equidistant from $(0,2)$ and $(4,0)$ because all square sides are equal. Its line is their equidistance locus.
For a general point $(x,y)$, equate squared distances: $x^2+(y-2)^2=(x-4)^2+y^2$. Cancelling quadratic terms leaves $8x-4y-12=0$, or $y=2x-3$.
stepsZh: 正方形边长相等，另一条对角线的两个端点到 $(0,2)$、$(4,0)$ 都等距，故该对角线位于它们的等距轨迹上。

tmua-2021-p2-q3.summary: If a uniformly selected class member wears glasses with probability $4/15$, which conditions must hold? I: exactly 11 do not wear glasses. II: the class size is divisible by 3. III: 8 out of 30 students wear glasses.
tmua-2021-p2-q3.summaryZh: 从一个班等概率抽取一人，其戴眼镜的概率为 $4/15$。判断哪些条件必成立：I．恰有 11 人不戴眼镜；II．班级人数为 3 的倍数；III．全班 30 人，其中 8 人戴眼镜。

methods.title: Scale the fraction in lowest terms
methods.titleZh: 利用最简分数确定人数比例
steps: Since $4/15$ is reduced, there must be $4k$ students wearing glasses in a class of $15k$, for some positive integer $k$. The class size is therefore divisible by $3$.
There are $11k$ students without glasses, so I would require $k=1$. III would require $k=2$. Neither value is forced.
stepsZh: 由于 $4/15$ 已是最简分数，全班应有 $15k$ 人，其中 $4k$ 人戴眼镜，$k$ 为正整数。故全班人数一定是 $3$ 的倍数。
不戴眼镜的有 $11k$ 人。I 要求 $k=1$，III 要求 $k=2$，但题设没有限定 $k$ 的值。

tmua-2021-p2-q4.summary: Test the implication $a\mid bc\Rightarrow a\mid b$ or $a\mid c$. Which triples $(a,b,c)$ disprove it: I $(5,10,20)$, II $(8,4,4)$, III $(6,7,12)$?
tmua-2021-p2-q4.summaryZh: 检验“$a\mid bc$ 推出 $a\mid b$ 或 $a\mid c$”。在三组 $(a,b,c)$ 中，哪些是反例：I $(5,10,20)$，II $(8,4,4)$，III $(6,7,12)$？

methods.title: Check divisibility before and after multiplication
methods.titleZh: 分别检验整除因子与乘积
steps: A counterexample needs $a$ to divide the product without dividing either factor. In I, $5$ already divides $10$. In III, $6$ already divides $12$.
For II, $8$ divides $4\cdot4=16$ but does not divide $4$, so the implication fails.
stepsZh: 反例须满足 $a$ 能整除乘积，却不能整除任何一个因子。I 中 $5$ 已能整除 $10$，III 中 $6$ 已能整除 $12$。
II 中 $8$ 整除 $4\cdot4=16$，却不整除 $4$，所以恰为反例。

tmua-2021-p2-q5.summary: An argument begins (A) $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$, (B) $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$ for every real $x$, then adds $1$, squares, and substitutes $\pi$ to claim $0=4$. Identify the earliest invalid step.
tmua-2021-p2-q5.summaryZh: 一段推理先写 (A) $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$，再写 (B) 对所有实数 $x$ 都有 $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$，然后加 $1$、平方、代入 $\pi$，得出 $0=4$。最早哪一步出错？
tmua-2021-p2-q5.answer: B. B: taking the principal square root
tmua-2021-p2-q5.answerZh: B．B：取主平方根时漏掉绝对值

methods.title: Track the sign of a square root
steps: A is the Pythagorean identity. It gives $\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}=\sqrt{\cos^2x}=|\cos x|$.
At $x=\pi$ the square root is $1$ and the cosine is $-1$. Thus B is already false.
stepsZh: A 是平方和的三角恒等式，推出的是 $\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}=\sqrt{\cos^2x}=|\cos x|$。
当 $x=\pi$ 时，平方根为 $1$，余弦却为 $-1$，因此 B 已经出错。

tmua-2021-p2-q6.summary: For a polynomial $f$, let P mean that $f$ has exactly three distinct real roots and Q that $f'$ has exactly two. Is P necessary or sufficient for Q?
tmua-2021-p2-q6.summaryZh: 对多项式 $f$，记 P 为“$f$ 恰有三个不同实根”，Q 为“$f'$ 恰有两个不同实根”。P 是 Q 的必要条件还是充分条件？

methods.title: Build counterexamples in each direction
methods.titleZh: 分别构造两个方向的反例
steps: For $f(x)=x(x^2-1)^2$, the distinct roots are $-1,0,1$, but $f'(x)=(x^2-1)(5x^2-1)$ has four distinct roots. Thus P does not suffice.
For $f(x)=x^3-3x+5$, the derivative has two roots, $-1$ and $1$. Both turning heights, $7$ and $3$, are positive, so the cubic crosses zero just once. P is unnecessary.
stepsZh: 取 $f(x)=x(x^2-1)^2$，它的不同实根为 $-1,0,1$，但 $f'(x)=(x^2-1)(5x^2-1)$ 有四个不同实根，可见 P 不充分。
再取 $f(x)=x^3-3x+5$，导数的两个实根为 $-1$ 与 $1$。两个极值分别为 $7$ 和 $3$，均为正，故该三次函数只穿过横轴一次。P 也不必要。

tmua-2021-p2-q7.summary: A single line halves the areas of a disk centred at $(9,-2)$ of radius $2$ and a square with corners $(\pm1,0),(\pm1,2)$. Find its horizontal intercept.
tmua-2021-p2-q7.summaryZh: 一条直线同时平分两个图形的面积：圆心为 $(9,-2)$、半径为 $2$ 的圆盘，以及顶点为 $(\pm1,0),(\pm1,2)$ 的正方形。求横截距。

methods.title: Join the centres of symmetry
steps: For a disk or square every line through its centre bisects area by a half-turn. Parallel translation away from that central line strictly reduces the area on one side, so any bisector must pass through the centre.
The square's centre is $(0,1)$. Its line to $(9,-2)$ has equation $y=1-x/3$, meeting the horizontal axis at $x=3$.
stepsZh: 对圆盘或正方形，过中心的直线借助半周旋转将面积平分。将它平行移离中心，一侧的面积就会减小，因此平分面积的直线必过中心。
正方形的中心是 $(0,1)$。连接它与 $(9,-2)$ 的直线为 $y=1-x/3$，故横截距为 $3$。

tmua-2021-p2-q8.summary: For a polynomial $p$ and $a<b$, determine whether $p(a)=p(b)$ is necessary or sufficient for $p'$ to vanish somewhere in $(a,b)$.
tmua-2021-p2-q8.summaryZh: 设 $p$ 是多项式且 $a<b$。要使 $p'$ 在 $(a,b)$ 内某处为零，$p(a)=p(b)$ 是必要条件还是充分条件？

methods.title: Use Rolle's theorem and test its converse
methods.titleZh: 应用罗尔定理并检验逆命题
steps: A polynomial is continuous on $[a,b]$ and differentiable inside it. When the endpoint values agree, Rolle's theorem supplies $c$ with $p'(c)=0$.
Conversely, take $p(x)=x^2$ on $[-1,2]$. The derivative vanishes at zero, although the endpoint values are $1$ and $4$.
stepsZh: 多项式在 $[a,b]$ 上连续、在内部可导。若两端函数值相等，罗尔定理保证存在 $c$ 使 $p'(c)=0$。
反过来，在 $[-1,2]$ 上取 $p(x)=x^2$。导数在零处为零，但两端的函数值为 $1$ 与 $4$，并不相等。

methods.title: Find an interior extremum
methods.titleZh: 寻找区间内部的极值点
steps: If $p$ is constant on $[a,b]$, every interior derivative vanishes. Otherwise some interior value differs from the common endpoint value.

For a larger interior value the global maximum must occur in the interior, and for a smaller one the global minimum must. At either interior extremum the derivative vanishes. The example $p(x)=x^2$ on $[-1,2]$ again shows the converse fails.
stepsZh: 若 $p$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上为常数，任一内点的导数都为零。否则，某个内点的函数值不同于两端共同的函数值。
若它较大，全区间最大值必在内部取得；若它较小，全区间最小值必在内部取得。在内点极值处导数为零。而 $p(x)=x^2$ 在 $[-1,2]$ 上仍说明逆命题不成立。

tmua-2021-p2-q9.summary: Which hypotheses separately guarantee that a real polynomial has a real root? I: it has degree three. II: its derivative vanishes somewhere. III: two of its values have negative product.
tmua-2021-p2-q9.summaryZh: 判断哪些条件单独就能保证实系数多项式有实根。I．次数为三；II．导数在某点为零；III．某两个函数值的乘积为负。

methods.title: Use opposite signs and continuity
steps: A cubic has opposite signs sufficiently far to its left and right. A negative product also supplies two inputs with opposite signs directly. In both cases continuity gives an intermediate zero.
For II, $f(x)=x^2+1$ has derivative zero at $0$ but stays strictly positive.
stepsZh: 三次多项式在充分靠左和充分靠右处异号。若两个函数值的乘积为负，也直接得到一对异号值。两种情形都由连续性保证中间存在零点。
对于 II，反例 $f(x)=x^2+1$ 在 $0$ 处导数为零，却恒为正数。

tmua-2021-p2-q10.summary: The sequence begins $15,21,30,37,44,51,59$ at indices $1$ through $7$. Find the first counterexample to “a prime index always has a term divisible by $3$ or $5$.”
tmua-2021-p2-q10.summaryZh: 数列从第 $1$ 项起依次为 $15,21,30,37,44,51,59$。求命题“若序号是质数，则该项能被 $3$ 或 $5$ 整除”的最小反例序号。

methods.title: Check prime indices in order
steps: The first prime indices are $2,3,5$. Their entries are $21,30,44$ respectively.
Both $21$ and $30$ are divisible by $3$, whereas $44$ is divisible by neither $3$ nor $5$. The first failure is at $5$.
stepsZh: 前三个质数序号为 $2,3,5$，对应的项依次为 $21,30,44$。
$21$ 与 $30$ 都能被 $3$ 整除，而 $44$ 既不能被 $3$ 整除也不能被 $5$ 整除，所以首次失败的序号是 $5$。

tmua-2021-p2-q11.summary: For nonzero $a,b$, a proof aims to deduce the existence of real $x,y$ with $a=xy(x+y),\,b=xy$ from $a^2-4b^3\ge0$. It instead starts with $(x-y)^2\ge0$, multiplies by $x^2y^2$, and substitutes $a,b$ to obtain the inequality. What has it proved?
tmua-2021-p2-q11.summaryZh: 对非零 $a,b$，欲从 $a^2-4b^3\ge0$ 推出存在实数 $x,y$ 满足 $a=xy(x+y),\,b=xy$。某证明从 $(x-y)^2\ge0$ 出发，乘以 $x^2y^2$ 并用 $a,b$ 代换，得到了题设不等式。它实际证明了什么？

methods.title: Separate necessity from existence
steps: Assuming the representation exists, $a^2-4b^3=x^2y^2((x+y)^2-4xy)=x^2y^2(x-y)^2\ge0$. This proves that the inequality is necessary.
To get existence from the inequality, take the roots of $t^2-(a/b)t+b=0$. Its discriminant $(a^2-4b^3)/b^2$ is nonnegative, and the sum and product of its roots give the desired representation.
stepsZh: 若所求表示已存在，则 $a^2-4b^3=x^2y^2((x+y)^2-4xy)=x^2y^2(x-y)^2\ge0$。这只证明了不等式的必要性。
要由不等式推出存在性，可取 $t^2-(a/b)t+b=0$ 的两根。其判别式 $(a^2-4b^3)/b^2$ 非负，而两根的和与积恰好给出所需表示。

tmua-2021-p2-q12.summary: For polynomials on $x\ge0$, judge three implications. I: $f\ge g$ implies their integrals from $0$ to every $x$ have the same order. II: $f\ge g$ implies $f'\ge g'$. III: $f'\ge g'$ implies $f\ge g$.
tmua-2021-p2-q12.summaryZh: 对 $x\ge0$ 上的多项式，判断三个推论。I．若 $f\ge g$，则对每个 $x$，从 $0$ 到 $x$ 的定积分也保持该大小关系；II．若 $f\ge g$ 则 $f'\ge g'$；III．若 $f'\ge g'$ 则 $f\ge g$。

methods.title: Test integration and differentiation separately
steps: The nonnegative function $f-g$ has nonnegative integral over every $[0,x]$, proving I. To refute II take $f=(x-1)^2$, $g=0$. Although $f\ge0$, its derivative at zero is $-2$.
To refute III, take the constants $f=-1$, $g=0$. Their derivatives agree everywhere while $f<g$.
stepsZh: 非负函数 $f-g$ 在每个 $[0,x]$ 上的积分均非负，故 I 成立。对 II 取 $f=(x-1)^2$、$g=0$，虽有 $f\ge0$，但其导数在 $0$ 处为 $-2$。
对 III，取常函数 $f=-1$、$g=0$，导数处处相等，却总有 $f<g$。

tmua-2021-p2-q13.summary: Throughout the region $y-x<3,\;y-x^2<1$, which bounds must hold? I: $-1<x<2$. II: $(y-x)(y-x^2)<3$. III: $y<5$.
tmua-2021-p2-q13.summaryZh: 在 $y-x<3,\;y-x^2<1$ 的公共区域内，哪些结论对每一点成立？I．$-1<x<2$；II．$(y-x)(y-x^2)<3$；III．$y<5$。

methods.title: Find points that violate the proposed bounds
steps: At $(4,6)$ the left sides of the region's inequalities are $2$ and $-10$. The point belongs to the region but violates both I and III.
At $(0,-2)$ both left sides are $-2$, so this point also belongs. Their product is $4$, contradicting II.
stepsZh: 在点 $(4,6)$ 处，定义区域的两个不等式的左边分别为 $2$ 和 $-10$。该点属于区域，但同时违反 I 和 III。
在 $(0,-2)$ 处，两个左边都为 $-2$，所以也属于区域。它们的乘积却是 $4$，推翻 II。

tmua-2021-p2-q14.summary: For which real $p$ does the pair $p\,2^x+\log_2 y=2$ and $2^x+\log_2 y=1$ have a real solution?
tmua-2021-p2-q14.summaryZh: 对于哪些实数 $p$，方程组 $p\,2^x+\log_2 y=2$、$2^x+\log_2 y=1$ 存在实数解？

methods.title: Eliminate the logarithm
steps: Subtracting gives $(p-1)2^x=1$. Since $2^x>0$, we need $p>1$.
Conversely, for any $p>1$ take $x=\log_2(1/(p-1))$ and $y=2^{1-2^x}>0$. Both equations then hold.

tmua-2021-p2-q15.summary: A circle satisfies $x^2+ax+y^2+by+c=0$ with nonzero $a,b,c$. What condition is necessary and sufficient for tangency to the vertical axis?
tmua-2021-p2-q15.summaryZh: 一个圆的方程为 $x^2+ax+y^2+by+c=0$，其中 $a,b,c$ 均非零。它与纵轴相切的充要条件是什么？

methods.title: Count the intercepts on the axis
methods.titleZh: 计算与坐标轴的交点数
steps: On the vertical axis put $x=0$. Intersection heights satisfy $y^2+by+c=0$. Tangency requires exactly one distinct height.
This occurs exactly when $b^2-4c=0$. Under this condition the circle has radius $|a|/2>0$, so it is nondegenerate.
stepsZh: 在纵轴上令 $x=0$，交点的纵坐标须满足 $y^2+by+c=0$。相切恰好要求只有一个不同的纵坐标。
这等价于 $b^2-4c=0$。此时圆的半径为 $|a|/2>0$，确为非退化圆。

methods.title: Compare the radius with the centre’s horizontal distance
methods.titleZh: 比较半径与圆心到纵轴的距离
steps: Complete the squares to find centre $(-a/2,-b/2)$ and squared radius $(a^2+b^2)/4-c$. Its squared distance to the vertical axis is $a^2/4$.
Tangency is equivalent to equality of these squared distances. Cancelling $a^2/4$ gives $b^2=4c$.
stepsZh: 分别配方可知圆心为 $(-a/2,-b/2)$，半径平方为 $(a^2+b^2)/4-c$，圆心到纵轴的距离平方为 $a^2/4$。
相切恰好要求距离与半径相等。将两者平方相等，消去 $a^2/4$，得 $b^2=4c$。

tmua-2021-p2-q16.summary: As the real parameters $p,q$ vary, which numbers of distinct real solutions can $x|x|=px+q$ have?
tmua-2021-p2-q16.summaryZh: 当实参数 $p,q$ 变化时，方程 $x|x|=px+q$ 的不同实根个数有哪些可能值？

methods.title: Count monotonic branches
steps: Let $h=x|x|-px$. It tends to opposite infinities at the two ends and has derivative $2|x|-p$. For $p\le0$ it is increasing. For $p>0$ it has three monotonic branches, so a horizontal line meets it at least once and at most three times.
For one solution take $p=q=0$. With $p=2$, the level $q=1$ touches at $x=-1$ and cuts again at $x=1+\sqrt2$, giving two. The level $q=0$ yields $-2,0,2$, giving three.
stepsZh: 令 $h=x|x|-px$，其两端分别趋于负、正无穷，且 $h'=2|x|-p$。当 $p\le0$ 时函数递增；当 $p>0$ 时有三段单调区间。因此水平线至少交一次、最多交三次。
取 $p=q=0$ 只得一根。若 $p=2,q=1$，水平线在 $x=-1$ 处相切，又在 $x=1+\sqrt2$ 处相交，共两根。若 $p=2,q=0$，根为 $-2,0,2$，共三根。

tmua-2021-p2-q17.summary: For $x>1$, set $f(x)=\log_2(\log_2\sqrt{x})$ and $g(x)=\log_2(\sqrt{\log_2x})$. Which constant always lies on the opposite side of $g(x)$ from $f(x)$, allowing equality: $0$, $1/2$ or $1$?
tmua-2021-p2-q17.summaryZh: 对于 $x>1$，设 $f(x)=\log_2(\log_2\sqrt{x})$，$g(x)=\log_2(\sqrt{\log_2x})$。在 $0,1/2,1$ 中，哪个常数能保证 $g(x)$ 总在它与 $f(x)$ 之间（允许相等）？

methods.title: Express both functions in one parameter
methods.titleZh: 用同一个参数表示两个函数
steps: Write $t=\log_2(\log_2 x)$. The inner logarithm in $f$ equals $(\log_2x)/2$, hence $f=t-1$. The square root inside $g$ gives $g=t/2$.
Consequently $g=(f+1)/2$. It lies midway between $f$ and $1$, whichever is larger.
stepsZh: 记 $t=\log_2(\log_2 x)$。$f$ 的内层对数为 $(\log_2x)/2$，故 $f=t-1$。$g$ 中的平方根则给出 $g=t/2$。
因而 $g=(f+1)/2$，它始终位于 $f$ 与 $1$ 的正中间，次序随两者大小而定。

tmua-2021-p2-q18.summary: A triangle has $AB=1$, $\sin A=x$ and $\sin B=y$ where $0<x<y<1$. Which counts of noncongruent triangles can occur for some such pair: one, two or three?
tmua-2021-p2-q18.summaryZh: 三角形满足 $AB=1$、$\sin A=x$、$\sin B=y$，且 $0<x<y<1$。随 $x,y$ 的选取，不全等三角形的个数可能是一、二、三中的哪些值？

methods.title: Compare the acute and supplementary angles
steps: Set $\alpha=\arcsin x$ and $\beta=\arcsin y$, so $0<\alpha<\beta<\pi/2$. If $A=\pi-\alpha$, even the smaller choice $B=\beta$ gives $A+B>\pi$. Thus $A=\alpha$.

Both $B=\beta$ and $B=\pi-\beta$ now work because $\alpha<\beta$. Each pair of angles and the fixed side determines one triangle. One has an obtuse $B$, while in the other any obtuse angle would be $C$; their angle sets cannot agree, since $\alpha>0$ makes $\pi-\alpha-\beta<\pi-\beta$.
stepsZh: 设 $\alpha=\arcsin x$、$\beta=\arcsin y$，有 $0<\alpha<\beta<\pi/2$。若 $A=\pi-\alpha$，即使 $B$ 取较小值 $\beta$，也有 $A+B>\pi$。故必有 $A=\alpha$。
因为 $\alpha<\beta$，此时 $B=\beta$ 或 $B=\pi-\beta$ 均可。每组角配上固定的边唯一确定一个三角形。后者有钝角 $\pi-\beta$；前者如果有钝角，也只能是 $\pi-\alpha-\beta$，严格更小，故两者不全等。

tmua-2021-p2-q19.summary: Among integer angles $1^\circ$ through $360^\circ$, how many satisfy $s\sqrt{1+s}\sqrt{1-s}+c\sqrt{1+c}\sqrt{1-c}=0$, where $s=\sin\theta,\ c=\cos\theta$?
tmua-2021-p2-q19.summaryZh: 在 $1^\circ$ 至 $360^\circ$ 的整数角中，令 $s=\sin\theta,\ c=\cos\theta$，有多少个角满足 $s\sqrt{1+s}\sqrt{1-s}+c\sqrt{1+c}\sqrt{1-c}=0$？

methods.title: Reduce the radicals to absolute values
steps: The two radical products simplify to $\sqrt{1-s^2}=|c|$ and $\sqrt{1-c^2}=|s|$. The condition is $s|c|+c|s|=0$, which holds for opposite signs or whenever either variable vanishes.
The open second and fourth quadrants contain $89$ integer angles each. Add the four axis angles to obtain $89+89+4=182$.
stepsZh: 两组根式分别等于 $\sqrt{1-s^2}=|c|$ 与 $\sqrt{1-c^2}=|s|$。原式化为 $s|c|+c|s|=0$，恰在两者异号或至少一个为零时成立。
第二、四象限内各有 $89$ 个整数角，再加上坐标轴上的四个角，合计 $89+89+4=182$。

tmua-2021-p2-q20.summary: Starting from $f_1(x)=|x|$, repeatedly set $f_{n+1}(x)=|f_n(x)+x|$. Compute $\int_{-1}^{1} f_{99}(x)\,dx$.

methods.title: Split the recurrence at zero
methods.titleZh: 在零点两侧分别处理递推
steps: For $x\ge0$, induction gives $f_n(x)=nx$. For $x<0$, the first two values are $-x$ and $0$, which repeat in alternation. The odd index $99$ therefore gives $-x$ on this half.
Integrate the two linear pieces: $\int_{-1}^0(-x)\,dx+\int_0^1 99x\,dx=1/2+99/2=50$.
stepsZh: 当 $x\ge0$，归纳可得 $f_n(x)=nx$。当 $x<0$ 时，前两项为 $-x$ 和 $0$，之后交替重复。下标 $99$ 为奇数，故负半轴上的函数为 $-x$。
